title: Massey University Alumni Doctoral Scholarship
about: Massey University's Alumni Doctoral Scholarship gives Massey graduates starting or early in a Massey doctorate $90,000 plus fees over three years. International and domestic, full- and part-time candidates can apply. Applications open 1 November 2026 and close 1 February 2027.
requirements: Hold a Massey University degree (undergraduate or postgraduate)
Hold an offer of place in a Massey doctoral programme, or be enrolled within the first 12 months of a doctorate by the closing date
International and domestic, full-time and part-time candidates are eligible
Successful applicants must enrol by 1 June of the award year

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Hold an offer of place in a Massey doctoral programme, or be enrolled within the first 12 months of a doctorate" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
"Any field (doctoral study)" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
